activation: Query cpg packages paths zstd and select the intended prefix; do not accidentally use a different host zstd.
Optionally add <prefix>/bin to PATH and <prefix>/lib/pkgconfig to PKG_CONFIG_PATH. Bundled API probes locate the selected library via relative RUNPATH.

notes: package.json provides a source/binary native-Zstd profile; material-profile.json is the unchanged original same-ID definition and provides every original source/test/reference file. Both use the existing pack --definition entry point; no resource ID was added.

Supported profile: Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, -O2 -g0 without -march=native, upstream multithreading and default legacy decoder settings. HAVE_ZLIB=0, HAVE_LZMA=0 and HAVE_LZ4=0 deliberately disable optional foreign-format CLI codecs, avoiding auto-linking to undeclared host libraries. Complete upstream code for those optional integrations remains in the material/source views.

Exact declared prerequisites are apt.build-essential=12.10ubuntu1, apt.file=1:5.45-3build1 for source build/tests, and apt.python3=3.12.3-0ubuntu2.1 for checks. Base Ubuntu POSIX tools and their actual versions are build-environment observations, not a claim that the entire APT closure was installed here.

Source builds run official make check, which intentionally excludes upstream long-data tests. Installed functional checks exercise the package-local C API, streaming with two workers, native CLI round trips, checksums, dictionary training/use, corrupt frames and original upstream golden decoder cases.
The material view performs no executable checks and reports not_run; full byte inventory still must verify. Historical metadata.catalog qualification flags are retained unchanged.

Relocation is limited to independently checked prefixes on the same declared Linux/Ubuntu/x86_64 target. Full fuzz/sanitizer matrix, all architectures, OCI images and benchmark performance remain separate qualification tasks. Binary-only installs do not imply the raw-source assets path exists.
usage.summary: Zstandard v1.5.7: native Zstd CLI, multithreaded compression, dictionaries and checked shared/static C libraries; original complete source/test material remains available under the same ID.
